lead.headline: Claim Boston before 02:00 — and fix two slots
lead.deck: Wilson is still in the protocol; Allgeier runs behind Carson Beck. 8.9 points sit on the bench as set.
lead.body: The bad news first: Garrett Wilson has not cleared the concussion protocol and practises first on Wednesday; Etienne's IR window is still shut; and Allgeier, the FLEX as set, now plays behind Carson Beck after Minshew's torn UCL. The lineup as set projects 123.7 against 132.6 — start Warren for Allgeier (6.9) and Wilson for Diggs (2.0, with Metcalf as the Sunday cover). Tonight's decision is the wire: Denzel Boston, Cleveland's target leader with either quarterback, for Alvin Kamara, who lost his early downs to Estime. Claims process at 02:00 Wednesday Mexico City time; priority resets weekly, so it costs nothing lasting.
